Longan Juice
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 6:28pm

Ingredients




6 cups water
1 pkt dried longans - (2 ½ oz) available at
Asian markets
cup sugar

Preparation

1 Bring water to boil and stir in longans. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in sugar. Chill thoroughly, 1 hour. 2 Pour over ice and serve immediately. 3 This recipe yields 4 servings.
